H1.body:
aNgu/ri, is, or aNgurI [L.], f. (for aNguli,
q.v.) a finger, AV.

H2.body: aNguli, is, (or aNgulI), f. a finger; a toe; the thumb; the great toe; the finger-like tip of an elephant's trunk; the measure aṅgula.
